methodologyNotes: Nine models covering top-searched premium and mid-range US hair straighteners. Specs and prices re-verified June 2026 against manufacturer product pages (dyson.com, chi.com, bioionic.com, ghdhair.com, babylisspro.com), official retailer pages (Ulta, Nordstrom, Dermstore, ProStylingTools), and product listings. All temperatures in Fahrenheit; plate_width_in is nominal styling plate width in decimal inches; heat_settings is the count of discrete settings (null when only a continuous/digital dial is confirmed); cordless, dual_voltage and auto_shutoff are boolean. Adversarial pass corrected: BaBylissPRO MSRP (manufacturer price), CHI auto_shutoff (analog model has none), and ghd Gold release year (nulled as unverifiable). accessedAt 2026-06-15.

products.name: Dyson Corrale
products.provenance: Price $539.99 confirmed directly on the dyson.com Corrale product page (a general web search snippet quoted $649.99, but the live product page shows $539.99). Three heat settings (330/365/410°F), max 410°F, cordless up to ~30 min, dual voltage, and flexing manganese-copper-alloy plates all confirmed on the same page. Auto shut-off (10 min inactivity) per Dyson manual. Release 2020 per Dyson press materials. Plate width ~1.0 in is the widely cited nominal figure (Dyson lists device dimensions, not a discrete plate-face inch value).

products.name: ghd Platinum+
products.priceNote: MSRP; offered $279 at multiple US retailers (Nordstrom, Amazon, ghdhair.com)
products.provenance: $279 confirmed at multiple US retailers (Nordstrom, Amazon, ghdhair.com); Sephora $289 / Bluemercury $319 show normal variance. Single preset 365°F (all ghd stylers run a fixed 365°F optimum, so heat_settings=1), dual voltage, 1-inch plates, and 30-min sleep auto-off confirmed on ghd/Nordstrom pages. Plate material is ceramic-coated aluminum per ghd. Source URL switched to the official ghd product page.

products.name: T3 Lucea ID
products.priceNote: Typical US retail; listed sold out at Nordstrom at time of access
products.provenance: Nordstrom product page confirmed CeraGloss ceramic plates, nine heat settings, 1-inch width, auto-world voltage (100-240V), and one-hour auto-off. Max 410°F is T3's standard HeatID ceiling for this line (range ~260-410°F across the 9 settings); the Nordstrom page does not print the discrete max, so this value is from T3's published HeatID spec. Price $235 reflects typical US retail (product currently sold out at Nordstrom); treat as approximate. Release ~2020 per listing history.

products.name: BaBylissPRO Nano Titanium 1½" Ultra-Thin
products.priceNote: Manufacturer price babylisspro.com (SKU BNT4073TUC); ProStylingTools lists regular $199.95 / sale $149.95
products.provenance: Nano Titanium plates, 50 heat settings, 450°F max, and 1.5-inch width confirmed at the official BaBylissPRO page (SKU BNT4073TUC) and ProStylingTools. Dual voltage confirmed. Price corrected: draft labeled $199.95 as MSRP, but the manufacturer's own site (babylisspro.com) lists $179.99; ProStylingTools shows regular $199.95 / sale $149.95. Using the $179.99 manufacturer price. Release date unverifiable -> null. Auto shut-off (60 min) per ProStylingTools.

products.name: CHI Original 1" Ceramic Hairstyling Iron
products.provenance: $100 and dual voltage confirmed at chi.com. Ceramic plates, 1-inch width, single pre-set 392°F (analog on/off, no user-adjustable temperature, so heat_settings=1) confirmed at chi.com and Target. auto_shutoff CORRECTED true->false: the GF1001 is the analog on/off model and has NO automatic shut-off (chi.com lists none; Target title explicitly says 'Analog On/Off Switch'). The draft confused it with the separate CHI Original DIGITAL model, which does have 1-hour auto-off.

products.name: Hot Tools Pro Artist Black Gold 1" Flat Iron
products.provenance: Ulta page confirmed list price $149.99, Black Gold ceramic/titanium/Micro-Shine surface, 1-inch floating plates, 455°F max, '30+ heat settings,' universal dual voltage, and 2-hour auto shut-off. heat_settings=30 is a conservative floor of the '30+' spec. Release year not published -> null.

products.name: Drybar The Tress Press 1.25" Straightening Iron
products.priceNote: US retail (Drybar/Nordstrom/Sephora); not re-confirmed on a primary page this pass
products.provenance: Titanium plates, 1.25-inch width, digital control up to 450°F, universal voltage, and 60-min auto shut-off confirmed at Drybar and via retailer descriptions. Uses a continuous digital temperature dial rather than discrete presets, so heat_settings is null. Price $169 is the well-established US retail figure; retailer pages (Drybar/Ulta/Sephora) blocked automated fetch this pass, so price is not freshly re-confirmed from a primary source but matches all prior listings. Release year not published -> null.

products.name: ghd Gold 1" Flat Iron
products.priceNote: MSRP, Dermstore (often discounted, e.g. ~$185-209 on sale)
products.provenance: $249 confirmed at Dermstore (sale ~$185). Ceramic-coated aluminum plates, fixed 365°F single preset (dual-zone sensors hold one optimum temp, so heat_settings=1), 1-inch plates, dual voltage, and 30-min auto sleep confirmed at Dermstore/ghd. releaseDate CORRECTED 2016->null: no primary source confirms a specific launch year for the current dual-zone Gold (retailer copy varies; the line evolved ~2016-2018). A null beats a guess.

products.name: Bio Ionic 10X Pro Styling Iron 1"
products.provenance: $262 confirmed at bioionic.com. BioCeramic plates with sonic vibration, 450°F max, dual voltage (120V-220V), and 1-hour auto shut-off confirmed at bioionic.com and Beauty Care Choices. Digital +/- temperature control (no discrete preset count) -> heat_settings null. Release 2025 corroborated: bioionic.com presents this as the 'New + Improved 10X' and the announcement article on the Bio Ionic blog is dated 24 June 2025.
